items.html: And see the matter of ChT"Kh (the letter-vessels), which are the two Achoraim of ZON — the three aspects that exist: one in HVYH, one in MNTzPCh, and one in Elokim. For the Nukva, at the time of the first emanation, was only one point alone, as is known; and this point is called "the pupil of the eye" (Ishon bat Ayin). Remember this. And from this point the building of her entire existence begins; and she alone can be face to face with him. And this is the root of all the aspects of the Nukva, and this is the beginning and end of all her discourses.
